title: Landskapslag (2008:124) om miljöskydd
evidence: Change list, entry 2008:124 (the Act as passed): "Denna lag träder i kraft den 1 december 2008." Opened https://www.regeringen.ax/alandsk-lagstiftning/alex/2008124 on 2026-11-10.
notes: Main environmental permit act of Åland (F2): purpose in 1 §, "främja en hållbar utveckling genom att undvika negativ miljöpåverkan"; permit and environmental review duties, emission limits, air protection plans. No climate-specific duty was found in the text; kept as the environmental framework entry. The record is the whole Ålex consolidation as served on 2026-11-10; the last amendment in its change list is 2025/73, in force 2025-11-01, and that date is the record in_force. Earlier consolidations are not served. Swedish only; no official English version found on regeringen.ax or the Ålex index.

title: Landskapslag (2009:31) om tillämpning i landskapet Åland av riksförfattningar om utsläppshandel
citation: Landskapslag (2009:31) om tillämpning i landskapet Åland av riksförfattningar om utsläppshandel, Ålex consolidation
evidence: Change list, entry 2009:31: "Denna lag träder i kraft den 1 augusti 2009." Opened https://www.regeringen.ax/alandsk-lagstiftning/alex/200931 on 2026-11-10.
notes: Narrower than a carbon-pricing family entry: the act applies the Finnish Emissions Trading Act (FFS 311/2011), the Kyoto Mechanisms Act (FFS 109/2007) and the aviation emissions Act (FFS 34/2010) on Åland (1 §) and moves the administrative tasks to the Åland Government; the substantive scheme is in the Finnish state acts (parent-state register rows, not stored). Fines for exceeded allowances go to Åland (5 §). The last amendment in the Ålex change list is 2015/105, in force 2016-05-01, which is the record in_force. Earlier consolidations are not served. Swedish only; no official English version found.

title: Landskapslag (2012:79) om tillämpning på Åland av lagen om avskiljning och lagring av koldioxid
citation: Landskapslag (2012:79) om tillämpning på Åland av lagen om avskiljning och lagring av koldioxid, Ålex consolidation
evidence: 5 §: "Denna lag träder i kraft den 1 januari 2013." Opened https://www.regeringen.ax/alandsk-lagstiftning/alex/201279 on 2026-11-10.
notes: Narrower than a climate framework entry: the act applies the Finnish Act on capture and storage of carbon dioxide (FFS 416/2012) on Åland within provincial competence and names the Åland authorities (2 §); the substantive rules are in the Finnish state Act (parent-state register row, not stored). No amendment is listed, so the Ålex text is the Act as passed and 2013-01-01 is the record in_force. Swedish only; no official English version found.

title: Landskapslag (2025:71) om tillämpning på Åland av lagen om biodrivmedel, flytande biobränslen och biomassabränslen
citation: Landskapslag (2025:71) om tillämpning på Åland av lagen om biodrivmedel, flytande biobränslen och biomassabränslen, Ålex
evidence: Change list, entry 2025:71: "Denna lag träder i kraft den 1 november 2025." Opened https://www.regeringen.ax/alandsk-lagstiftning/alex/202571 on 2026-11-10.
notes: Narrower than a climate framework entry: the act applies the Finnish Act on biofuels, bioliquids and biomass fuels (FFS 393/2013) on Åland (1 §) and names the Åland authorities (2 §); the sustainability rules are in the Finnish state Act (parent-state register row, not stored). It repealed landskapslag (2018:41) (ax-biodrivmedel-ghg-lag-2018-41) from the same date. No amendment is listed, so the Ålex text is the Act as passed. Swedish only; no official English version found.

title: Landskapslag (2018:41) om tillämpning på Åland av rikslagstiftning om biodrivmedel och flytande biobränsle samt om minskning av växthusgasutsläpp från vissa drivmedel
citation: Landskapslag (2018:41) ... om minskning av växthusgasutsläpp från vissa drivmedel, Ålex (repealed)
evidence: Change list, entry 2018:41: "Denna lag träder i kraft den 1 oktober 2018." Opened https://www.regeringen.ax/alandsk-lagstiftning/alex/201841 on 2026-11-10.
notes: Repealed. The brief listed it as a candidate in force; the Ålex page is headed "(upphävd)" and says "Denna lag har upphävts genom 2025:71 , som gäller från och med den 1 november 2025." Narrower than a climate framework entry: it applied the Finnish biofuels act (FFS 393/2013) and the Finnish act on lifecycle greenhouse gas reduction in fuels (FFS 170/2018) on Åland. Two records: the text Ålex still serves (in_force 2018-10-01, no amendment listed; the repeal banner is part of the served page) and a repeal record dated 2025-11-01. Whether FFS 170/2018 still applies on Åland after the repeal was not read. Swedish only.
